in_hindi.name: जयवंती
in_hindi.long_meaning: जय: विजयी (Vijayī) जीवन में विजय प्राप्त करना चाहती वाली, विजय व्यक्ति, विजय दान दिलाने वाली (A person who desires to acquire victory in life, a victorious person, a giver of victory)

in_telugu.name: జైవాంటీ
in_telugu.meaning: జై: జీवితే జీవిత జీద్దేశ్యోద్యేశ్య (Jai: Possessor of life, owner of life, lord of life)
in_telugu.long_meaning: జై: జీవితే జీవిత జీద్దేశ్యోద్యేశ్య (Jai: One who holds the power of life in their hands, the giver and sustainer of life, the lord of life)

in_marathi.name: Jaiwanti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory brings desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaiwanti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jaiwanti is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jai' meaning victory and 'wanti' meaning desire. In Hindu mythology, Jaiwanti is the name of a goddess who embodies the desire for victory. She is believed to grant success and prosperity to those who worship her.
